newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VILENZO SEES NLG 10 MLN NET PROFIT IN 97.
newsitem.headline: VILENZO SEES NLG 10 MLN NET PROFIT IN 97.

text.p: Textiles group Vilenzo NV said on Wednesday it expected to post higher full-year profits in 1997 of around 10 million guilders.
In 1996 the company posted full-year net of 9.8 million guilders.
"Management expects that 1997 net profit will reach the level of 10 million guilders," Vilenzo said in a statement.
It added that this result would represent a "substantial improvement" on the 9.8 million guilder net profit of 1996, which included an extraordinary gain of 2.4 million guilders.
Vilenzo said it was still faced with extremely difficult market conditions in western Europe, but said this was offset by the positive effects of restructuring and cost-saving measures.
The sales activities of its production facilities had resulted in additional turnover in new markets outside the European Union, it added.
